en: Black-and-white panoramic view over a small European town with dense, steeply pitched tiled roofs. A masonry bridge with metal railings crosses a narrow river or canal in the foreground, with pedestrians walking across. Streets curve between three- to four-story masonry houses with shopfronts at ground level. In the mid‑ground and distance are more residential buildings and a small church with a simple tower, while open agricultural fields and a smokestack lie on the horizon. The overall scene suggests an early‑20th‑century central European town.
